rule: Own being receives nothing, so its determinations are pure
meaning: A being with no represented limiting principle is its own being by UNLIMITED-IS-OWN-BEING-FROM-RECEPTION (same four premises); what is its own being is no recipient (STMT-OWN-BEING-IS-NO-RECIPIENT, q.4 a.1 ad 3); and a being that is no recipient has only pure determinations (STMT-NON-RECIPIENT-DETERMINATIONS-ARE-PURE, q.7 a.1 generalized). Derives the former bare bridge STMT-UNLIMITED-DETERMINATIONS-ARE-PURE for an arbitrary carrier of determinations. All six premises stay open; the two new ones are supported, not stated.
